svg.title: Circuit Breaker
svg.desc: Circuit Breaker. Stop calling a failing dependency, fail fast with a fallback, and probe until it recovers. Step 1, Closed: Closed: calls flow through to Service B while the breaker counts failures. Step 2, Failures pile up: Service B starts failing. Three failures in a row trip the breaker open. Step 3, Open: fail fast: Open: calls fail fast with a fallback, so Service B gets time to recover. Step 4, Half-open trial: Half-open: after the cooldown one trial call is let through; it succeeds, so the breaker closes.

g.text: Closed: calls flow through to Service B while the breaker counts failures.
Service B starts failing. Three failures in a row trip the breaker open.
Open: calls fail fast with a fallback, so Service B gets time to recover.
Half-open: after the cooldown one trial call is let through; it succeeds, so the breaker closes.
